item.title: Ohio’s 2025 Weeklong Deer Gun Hunting Season Results
item.description: PRESS RELEASE – Ohio hunters checked 85,448 deer during the weeklong gun season that concluded on Sunday, Dec. 7, according to the Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) Division of Wildlife.
